description: Single-IP investigation with L4/application pies, peers, and services.

targets.query:
SELECT sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND '$ip' != ''
  AND (
        ('$role' = 'any' AND (
            if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
         OR if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip'
        ))
     OR ('$role' = 'src' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip')
     OR ('$role' = 'dst' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip')
  )

panels.description: Traffic over time split by as_source / as_destination / both

targets.query:
SELECT
    $timeSeries AS t,
    multiIf(
        if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
          AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip',
        'both',
        if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip',
        'as_source',
        'as_destination'
    ) AS direction,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND '$ip' != ''
  AND (
        ('$role' = 'any' AND (
            if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
         OR if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip'
        ))
     OR ('$role' = 'src' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip')
     OR ('$role' = 'dst' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip')
  )
GROUP BY t, direction
ORDER BY t

panels.title: Traffic trend by role

targets.query:
SELECT
    peer,
    protocol,
    sum(traffic) AS traffic,
    sum(flows) AS flows
FROM
(
    SELECT
        if(
            if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip',
            if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)),
            if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr))
        ) AS peer,
        multiIf(
            nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') != '',
            dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)),
            nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)), '') != '',
            dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)),
            concat('port-', toString(dst_port))
        ) AS protocol,
        bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate) AS traffic,
        1 AS flows
    FROM $table
    WHERE $timeFilter
      AND '$ip' != ''
      AND (
            ('$role' = 'any' AND (
                if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
             OR if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip'
            ))
         OR ('$role' = 'src' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip')
         OR ('$role' = 'dst' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip')
      )
)
WHERE peer != '' AND peer != '$ip'
GROUP BY peer, protocol
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT toUInt64OrZero('$topn')

SELECT
    ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)) AS protocol,
    dst_port,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic,
    count() AS flows
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND '$ip' != ''
  AND (
        ('$role' = 'any' AND (
            if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
         OR if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip'
        ))
     OR ('$role' = 'src' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip')
     OR ('$role' = 'dst' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip')
  )
GROUP BY protocol, dst_port
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT toUInt64OrZero('$topn')

panels.description: Aggregated flow rows for the IP. Adjust Detail rows variable.

targets.query:
SELECT
    if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(sampler_address), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(sampler_address)) AS exporter,
    if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) AS source,
    if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) AS destination,
    ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)) AS protocol,
    src_port,
    dst_port,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic,
    sum(packets * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS packets,
    count() AS flows
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND '$ip' != ''
  AND (
        ('$role' = 'any' AND (
            if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
         OR if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip'
        ))
     OR ('$role' = 'src' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip')
     OR ('$role' = 'dst' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip')
  )
GROUP BY exporter, source, destination, protocol, src_port, dst_port
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT toUInt64OrZero('$detail_rows')

panels.description: Layer-4 protocol mix for this IP (TCP / UDP / ICMP / …).

targets.query:
SELECT
  multiIf(
    proto = 6, 'TCP',
    proto = 17, 'UDP',
    proto = 1, 'ICMP',
    proto = 58, 'ICMPv6',
    proto = 47, 'GRE',
    ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), concat('Other(', toString(proto), ')'))
  ) AS protocol,
  sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND '$ip' != ''
  AND (
        ('$role' = 'any' AND (
            if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
         OR if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip'
        ))
     OR ('$role' = 'src' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip')
     OR ('$role' = 'dst' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip')

GROUP BY protocol
ORDER BY traffic DESC
